task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the sum of even numbers at even positions of an integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SumEvenNumbersAtEvenPositions(arr: array<int>) returns (sum: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The output sum equals the sum of all even numbers located at even indices in the input array (considering 0-based indexing)
    - All elements summed are even
    - Only elements at even positions (indices 0, 2, 4, ...) are considered in the sum
